expiration policy. The cache automatically evicts entries whose lifetime has

=====================================

A thread-safe LRU cache that automatically expires entries after a configurable
time-to-live (TTL) period.

Design Overview
---------------

   of the list to enforce the LRU policy.
3. ``TTLExpiry`` : A background thread that periodically checks for expired
   entries and removes them.
4. ``ThreadSafeLRUCache`` : A wrapper that adds a threading lock to ensure
   that concurrent access does not corrupt the internal data structures.
5. ``PytestCache`` : A pytest fixture that provides a fresh, thread-safe cache
   instance for each test case to avoid cross-test contamination.

The module is deliberately written without external dependencies beyond the
standard library to remain portable and easy to test.

--------------
* ``max_size`` : Limits the number of entries stored. When the limit is
  reached, the least recently used entry is evicted.
* ``ttl`` : Defines how long a value remains valid (in seconds). When an entry

  explicit access.
